sql.processStepAction.deleteAction: update flow.process_step_action set modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now(), archived = true where id = :actionId

dfp.data_type_id as "dataTypeId", dfp.parameter_type_id as "parameterTypeId", dfp.display_order as "displayOrder", ppscfv.text_value as "textValue", ppscfv.date_value as "dateValue", sql.processStepAction.actionLogicString: with logic as ( select case when ot.operation_type is not null then ot.operation_type when obt.id in (1, 2, 3, 4) then concat(upper(obt.object_type), ': ', case when ps.process_step_name is not null then concat(ps.process_step_name, ': ') end, cfg.group_name, ' - ', cf.field_name, ' ', opt.operator_type, ' ', coalesce(psr.requirement_value, dtr.data_type_value), case when psr.secondary_requirement_value is not null then concat('(', psr.secondary_requirement_value, ')') end, case when custom_sql_option_id is not null then concat('<', cf.custom_field_sql_key, '> Option: ', custom_sql_option_id) end) when psr.company_function_id is not null then concat('FUNCTION: ', company_function_name, ' ', opt.operator_type, ' ', coalesce(psr.requirement_value, dtr.data_type_value)) when process_step_requirement_type_id = 7 then concat('Company PS Status of ', ref_ps.process_step_name, ' in (', array_to_string( array(select process_step_status_type from flow.company_process_step_status_type cpst where cpst.id = any (list_of_value_ids)), ','), ')') when process_step_requirement_type_id = 8 then concat('ROOT PS Status of ', ref_ps.process_step_name, ' in (', array_to_string( array(select process_step_status_type from flow.process_step_status_type cpst where cpst.id = any (list_of_value_ids)), ','), ')') when process_step_requirement_type_id = 9 then concat('Company Project Status in (', array_to_string(array(select project_status_type from flow.company_project_status_type cpst where cpst.id = any (list_of_value_ids)), ','), ')') when process_step_requirement_type_id = 10 then concat('ROOT Project Status in (', array_to_string(array(select project_status_type from flow.project_status_type cpst where cpst.id = any (list_of_value_ids)), ','), ')') end as value from flow.process_step_action_logic psl left join flow.operation_type ot on psl.operation_type_id = ot.id left join flow.process_step_requirement psr on psl.process_step_requirement_id = psr.id left join flow.operator_type opt on psr.operator_type_id = opt.id left join flow.data_type_requirement dtr on psr.data_type_requirement_id = dtr.id left join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on psr.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfga.id left join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfga.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id left join flow.process_step ps on cfg.process_step_id = ps.id left join flow.company_object_type cot on cfg.company_object_type_id = cot.id left join flow.object_type obt on cot.object_type_id = obt.id left join flow.custom_field cf on cfga.custom_field_id = cf.id left join flow.company_function cfn on psr.company_function_id = cfn.id left join flow.process_step ref_ps on ref_ps.id = psr.reference_process_step_id where psl.process_step_action_id = :actionId and psl.archived is false order by psl.sql_order ) select sql.processStepAction.addSmsToAction: insert into flow.process_step_action_message_template (process_step_action_id, message_template_id, sms_team_ids, created_by_id, date_created, modified_by_id, date_modified) values (:processStepActionId, :messageTemplateId, array[ :teamIds ]::bigint[], :createdById, now(), :createdById, now())
sql.processStepAction.getActionChildSms: select psamt.id, psamt.process_step_action_id, psamt.message_template_id, psamt.archived, psamt.date_created, psamt.date_modified, psamt.created_by_id, psamt.modified_by_id, to_jsonb(psamt.sms_team_ids) as teamIds, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(team))) FROM ( select st.id, st.team_name as "teamName" from flow.sms_team st where st.id = any(psamt.sms_team_ids) and st.archived is false ) team), '[]') AS "teams", mt.title from flow.process_step_action_message_template psamt inner join flow.message_template mt on mt.id = psamt.message_template_id where psamt.id = :id
sql.processStepAction.deleteSmsFromAction: update flow.process_step_action_message_template set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.processStepAction.getChildSmsTemplatesBy: select psamt.id, psamt.archived, psamt.process_step_action_id as "processStepActionId", psamt.message_template_id as "messageTemplateId", psamt.created_by_id as "createdById", psamt.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", mt.title, mt.message, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(team))) FROM ( select st.id, st.team_name as "teamName" from flow.sms_team st where st.id = any(psamt.sms_team_ids) and st.archived is false ) team), '[]') AS "teams", to_jsonb(psamt.sms_team_ids) as teamIds from flow.process_step_action_message_template psamt inner join flow.message_template mt on mt.id = psamt.message_template_id where psamt.process_step_action_id = :processStepActionId and psamt.archived is not true
